title: Hawaiian Haystacks
description: Hawaiian haystacks are a great way to layer leftover rice, chicken, pineapple, and Cheddar cheese for a tropical weeknight dinner.
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into small cubes
1 (10.75 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat; cook and stir chicken in the hot oil until no longer pink in the center, 5 to 7 minutes. Add chicken broth; simmer until slightly reduced, about 5 minutes. Mix cream of mushroom soup, basil, and parsley into chicken mixture until smooth; cook until warmed, about 5 minutes. Transfer chicken sauce to a small bowl.

Spread cooked rice onto a serving platter; top with chicken sauce. Layer pineapple, green bell pepper, Cheddar cheese, tomatoes, chow mein noodles, almonds, green onions, and coconut, respectively, onto chicken sauce.

video.description: Infuse the flavors of the islands into your meal time, and mix and match your toppings in this delicious medley of savory, sweet, creamy and crunchy. This satisfying dish serves up fresh vegetables, sweet pineapple, creamy chicken rice and crunchy nuts and chow mein noodles in a unique stack of flavors.
